generic.title: Sorry — that didn't work
generic.description: We couldn't complete that just now. Please try again. If the problem keeps happening, copy this code and send it to Libriant support: {code}.
validation.email: Please enter a valid email address.
validation.tooLong: Please use no more than {max} characters.
permission.denied: You don't have permission to do that.
notFound.title: We couldn't find that
notFound.description: The thing you were looking for isn't here. It may have been removed.
quotaExceeded.title: You've reached your plan's limit
quotaExceeded.description: Your plan allows up to {limit} {resource}. Upgrade your plan to add more.
network.timeout: The server isn't responding. Nothing was lost — please try again in a moment.
network.unreachable: We can't reach Libriant right now. Check your connection and try again.
http.badRequest: Some of the details weren't accepted. Please check what you entered and try again.
http.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
http.conflict: Someone else changed this while you were working on it. Reload the page and try again.
http.tooLarge: That file is too large. Please choose a smaller one.
http.unsupportedMedia: That kind of file isn't accepted here.
http.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a short time. Please wait a minute and try again.
http.server: Something broke on our side. Our team can see it — please try again in a few minutes.
http.unavailable: Libriant is briefly unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes.
http.maintenance: Libriant is down for scheduled maintenance. Please try again shortly.
planFeature.description: This isn't included in your library's current plan.
planFeature.named: Not included in your library's current plan: {feature}.
quotaExceeded.descriptionUnnamed: Your plan allows up to {limit}. Upgrade your plan to add more.
